description: Sanity check: train the same MLP discriminator (128, 64 hidden) on two independent random halves of the real top-jet HLV data. AUC should collapse to 0.5 if the architecture is calibrated.
interpretation: The MLP cannot distinguish two random halves of real data (AUC ~ 0.5 within statistical floor). The architecture is calibrated at chance, so the BUFF vs real AUC ~= 0.997 reflects genuine distributional differences rather than discriminator-architecture overfitting.
